newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia job growth best in 10 years - paper.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia job growth best in 10 years - paper.

text.p: For the first time in a decade, Philadelphia has posted three straight quarters of year-over-year job growth, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Wednesday.
Citing U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, the newspaper said the number of jobs in the city rose by 3,300, or 1/2 percent, in the first quarter of 1997.
Even with the improvement, however, Philadelphia has 104,000 fewer jobs that it had 10 years ago.
Job growth in the eight counties surrounding Philadelphia has risen 2.4 percent since the first quarter of 1996.
